resources.string: Features picked from Infinity X, AxionOS, uwuAOSP and Evolution X
Everyone who made Miku-Picked UI possible
Show a small logo in the status bar (from Infinity X)
Show the battery level as a thin bar at the top of the screen (from Infinity X)
Leave empty to show the real network name (from Evolution X)
Restart into recovery or bootloader, or restart only SystemUI, from the power menu (from AxionOS / LineageOS)
Quiet your phone at night (from Evolution X)
Let chosen apps draw behind the display cutout (from uwuAOSP)
This device has no display cutout
Swipe down on the left half for notifications and on the right half for quick settings (portrait only)
Show notifications and quick settings side by side in landscape on devices that support it
Vibrate while dragging the volume dialog sliders
Flash the screen when taking a screenshot
Crop the status bar out of full screen screenshots
Takes effect after a reboot, or after Restart SystemUI in the advanced restart menu
Length, position, notifications, alerts and card design
Miku-Picked UI is Miku UI plus features cherry-picked from other projects. Thank you!
The base of everything: Miku UI Android 16 (Blooming V2) and all of its features
HALs, LineageOS 23.2 device tree compatibility, advanced restart menu, power menu helpers

AxionFx audio effects, resizable home screen folders (Localhorst04, Saikrishna1504, rmp22), status/nav bar burn-in protection, advanced restart with Restart SystemUI, flashlight fade, 5G tile, the emoji style switch
Deep sleep time in uptime, auto brightness tile, full screen apps for display cutouts
Custom lockscreen clocks (with crDroid and risingOS), fingerprint icons, selectable emoji, sleep mode, QS tile toggle animations, custom carrier label, volume slider haptics switch
Separate notifications and quick settings shade, landscape split shade switch, screenshot flash and status bar options
The dynamic island, by Spottq, with additions by csabaikende-ctrl
Samsung Galaxy S21 Exynos (o1s) device trees, kernel and vendor, Samsung and SLSI hardware (ata-kaner, mst8981, Flopster101)
Galaxy S21 Exynos trees and kernel used here, with fixes for VoLTE, eSIM, NFC, WPA3 hotspot, 60 fps video and charge limit
crDroid, AICP, OmniROM, PixelExperience and more
Where many of the picked features were first written
Each picked commit keeps its original author in the git history
Claude Opus 5.5 ported and integrated the picked features, and wrote the LineageOS device tree compatibility
Pick one of 85 custom lockscreen clock styles (from Evolution X)
Swipe left or right to preview the clock styles
SystemUI restarts to apply the new clock style. The screen may flicker for a moment.
Animate the clock when the screen goes to and comes back from the always-on display
A custom clock style replaces the AOSP lockscreen clock. Color, size, opacity and margin apply to the custom styles only. Weather in the clock styles is not available.
Pick the icon shown over the in-display fingerprint sensor
Show music and ongoing activities (flashlight, timers, calls) on the lock screen. Tap the music to open a large player
Liquid Glass for the shade, Quick Settings, notifications, the PIN pad, dialogs, the island and the Now Bar (from PenguinOS)
Media volume under the brightness slider (from PenguinOS)
How much the notification shade and Quick Settings blur what is behind them. Lower it if the shade stutters; 0 turns the blur off
Liquid Glass tab bars in apps
Turn apps\' buttons into iOS 26 style glass capsules in their own color, that squish when pressed. Compose apps\' buttons stay as they are. Reopen apps to apply
Turn 5G off while the hotspot or USB tethering is on, so the phone runs cooler and uses less battery. Your preferred network type comes back when tethering stops
Turn apps\' bottom navigation bars into a glass capsule with liquid motion (from PenguinOS). Reopen apps to apply
Float tab bars over the page
Let content scroll under the glass tab bar in apps built with Compose
Apps grow out of their icon and fly back into it on ColorOS / OxygenOS springs, with a little bounce as they land (from PenguinOS)
When you unlock to the home screen, the lockscreen clock flies onto a Lockscreen clock widget while the home screen zooms in. Turning this on adds the widget to your home screen
How strongly the glass edges bend what is behind them
Custom (your emoji font, pick again to change)
That file could not be used. Pick a TrueType (.ttf) or OpenType (.otf) emoji font.
The new emoji style is used after a restart.
While music plays and the screen is off, hold volume up for the next track or volume down for the previous one
Make apps see this phone as a Google phone, so watch apps that only work with Pixel phones (like Pixel Watch) can pair. Needs a restart.
The change is used after a restart.
The open emoji styles: Blobmoji by C1710 (Apache 2.0), OpenMoji by HfG Schwäbisch Gmünd (CC BY-SA 4.0), Twemoji by Twitter and contributors (CC BY 4.0)
GoogleSpoofForWear, the idea behind the Google spoof for wearables toggle
System-wide Liquid Glass (SurfaceFlinger\'s renderengine) and the glass Quick Settings, PIN pad and notifications, backported to Android 16 with permission
The reverse engineered ViPER4Android FX: AxionFx Clarity, Dynamic System and Speaker optimization, used with permission (via WSTxda\'s fork)
Apps that block screenshots (banking, private browsing, passwords) can be captured in screenshots, screen recordings and recents. Protected video still shows black
Apps aren\'t told when you take a screenshot of them
Check whether apps can see your screenshots, and whether secure screens can be captured
Take a screenshot while this screen is open. If it is counted here, apps can see your screenshots
Last one at %1$s. Apps can see your screenshots
Blocks screenshots of this screen, like a banking app does. With \"Allow screenshots in secure apps\" on, they still work
Charge faster on fast wireless chargers. The phone gets warmer while it does
Charge earbuds, a watch or another phone by placing it on the back of this one. Also a Quick Settings tile
Wireless PowerShare turns off when the battery drops to this level
